title: Razkadr eval labels
description: Ground-truth labels of one reference video (naryad 003): marked moments by role. Lives at data/eval/labels/<video_id>.json next to data/eval/videos/<video_id>.mp4 and a SOURCES.md row. See data/eval/README.md.

video_id.description: Video identifier; must match the file name stems of data/eval/videos/<video_id>.mp4 and of this labels file.

items.description: Tags from the fixed dictionary: language (ru, en), audio (voice, silent), onscreen-text, poor-quality.

hero.description: Appetizing hero moments (ready dish, main shot); eval-check requires at least 1.

ingredients.description: Ingredient layout moments; eval-check requires at least 1.

steps.description: Process steps in chronological order; eval-check requires at least 5.

t.description: Marked moment, seconds from the start of the video; must not exceed the video duration.

note.description: Optional human note, e.g. what happens at this moment.

schemaVersion.description: Artifact schema version, semver (patch may be omitted).
